steps.name: When a token exchange is attempted without an idToken
Then the response status should be 400

expected 400; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-10-20T07:18:18.543","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"This field is required","path":"/api/auth/exchange-token","requestId":"REQ-5a364524","messageKey":"error.validation.required_field"}
And the error message should contain "required"
error body must carry the contract message
